name: DevCtl
description: Dev-control panel for the workspace — a piloted browser. Observes and controls the aw-app-browser container over CDP (aw-app-browser:9223): live screenshot, screencast over a WebSocket, navigate, click/type/key/scroll, and evaluate/inject JS (DOM control). Ported from the monolith whiteboard piloted-browser. Backend routes under /api/apps/devctl (use via API for now; an MCP-gateway tool wrapper comes later).
